description: Use when assessing the TLS configuration of a service you own or are authorized to test, or when decrypting your own captured traffic for troubleshooting. Covers certificate chain validation with openssl, protocol and cipher enumeration, testssl.sh comprehensive scans, TLS keylog decryption in Wireshark, and JA3/JA4 fingerprinting for detection. Use when a scanner flags weak ciphers, when you need to prove a misconfiguration, or when encrypted traffic must be inspected defensively.
